mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 60 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Public Library.

Mayor Diaz has designated October as Community Planning Month to honor the Planning and Development Department for their dedication to our city's growth and infrastructure. Additionally, the Verona Senior Center is now offering free rides on a tri-shaw bike along the Military Ridge State Trail.
There is a busy schedule today including the World Dairy Expo, the Farley Center Fall Festival, and live music at Bailey's Run. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
On Sunday, September 21, a retail theft incident occurred involving the theft of Swedish Fish candy from a store in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Andes Mint Avalanche and the restaurant is currently open until 10:00 PM.
